recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, airbrushed illustration of open, glossy lips with visible teeth and tongue, set within a black circular void against a solid bubblegum pink background. The composition is framed by dynamic, stylized custom lettering that follows the curve of the circle and overlaps the central imagery.
coreVisualRelationships: The black circle acts as a high-contrast stage for the fleshy, organic forms of the lips.
The sharp, angular lettering in the upper left balances the soft, rounded volume of the mouth.
The yellow script at the bottom follows the circular path, creating a sense of orbital movement.
The bubblegum pink background provides a flat, saturated field that pushes the central graphic forward.
coreInvariants: Glossy airbrushed highlights on the lips
Overlapping relationship between text and the central circle

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The mouth is the central subject, scaled to fill approximately 60% of the black circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black circle serves as the primary visual anchor, grounding the floating elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large purple lettering, follows the curve of the lips down to the yellow script, and circles back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The solid pink background acts as expansive negative space, focusing all attention on the central medallion.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bubblegum pink background and deep red lip tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Solid black circle providing depth and separation.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric purple, lime green, and bright yellow for typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; value contrast is highest between the black circle and the white teeth/highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Angular, stylized script and brush-like cursive.
letterConstructionRules: Upper text uses thick, blocky strokes with sharp, pointed terminals and internal decorative lines.
Lower text uses a fluid, monolinear brush script with a consistent slant.
All text features high-contrast outlines (lime green or yellow) to separate it from the background.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has an elongated, sweeping tail that frames the top of the circle.
The script letters are connected and follow a precise arc path.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy, angular display lettering and light, rhythmic brush script.

preserve: The arc of the bottom text
The multi-line fill of the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the era's expressive, hand-drawn energy.
Captures the sharp angles and layered outlines of the top text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid bubblegum pink square. In the center, place a perfect black circle. Inside the circle, illustrate a pair of open, glossy red lips with white teeth and a pink tongue using a 1970s airbrush style with soft highlights and deep shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom vector lettering. The top text should be large, purple with a lime green outline, using sharp angular strokes. The bottom text should be a yellow brush script following the bottom curve of the black circle.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, solid pink?
Are the lips rendered with airbrush-style highlights?
Does the text overlap the black circle edges?
Is the color palette limited to pink, black, red, purple, green, and yellow?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or band logos
Specific facial features beyond the lips

mustAchieve: Smooth airbrush gradients on the lips
Clean, sharp vector-like edges on the lettering

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the teeth are bright white and distinct.
Check that the purple lettering has a visible green outline.
Verify the yellow script follows a perfect arc.
Confirm the black circle is perfectly centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid [Color A] background + Central [Color B] circle + Airbrushed [Subject] + Arced [Script Style] lettering.
